enchantments.tooltip: Combat Mastery +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Profane Combat Mastery +3: +3 Profane bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Kick 'Em While They're Down: You have 5 more attack and deal 5 more damage to enemies that are knocked down or stunned.
Crippling: A crippling weapon is infused with binding power so that when a target is critically hit their movement is slowed by half.Note: Real slowdown is only 25%
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
